correctness.rationale: The full 33-line model is explicit. Exact R=Z[omega]/(omega^2+omega+2) calculations evaluate all 528 pair minors and 5456 triple determinants. All nonzero determinants and pair-minor norm gcds have prime divisors only 2,3,7,11; this proves uniform generic incidence outside those four primes, not by sampling. At each exceptional prime exact residue calculations classify projectively distinct lines and every incidence class: p2 seven lines/7 triple, p3 33 lines/(24,4,27,24,6), p7 21 lines/(0,28,21,0,0), p11 33/(48,40,15,0,18). All class sizes satisfy the pairwise intersection accounting. A standalone Python standard-library verifier checked all numerical certificates and stepwise proofs were reconstructed.

originality.rationale: The principal novelty is the arithmetic Galois-closed rational union of two conjugate Klein line models, with 33 lines, its full generic intersection lattice, four exact exceptional primes and full exceptional fibers. Bauer et al. describe the individual 21-line Klein incidence and characteristic seven; Gévay and Pokora show Galois-conjugate 21-line realizations are natural; Innamorati gives the 21-line equations and their characteristic-seven finite-plane geometry. Those statements do not imply the cross-concurrences of the 33-line union. Targeted published-finding corpus and literature queries gave no directly covering 33-line theorem. A specialized earlier arithmetic-matroid classification could still subsume this, so priority remains uncertain.
residual_risks: An older study may already classify the exact 33-line Galois-conjugate union, perhaps under a different name.
Exact counts apply only to the coordinate-defined conjugate union; no uniqueness theorem for all rational models is asserted.

value.rationale: The minimal Galois-stable union of a Klein arrangement and its conjugate is a natural rational line divisor motivated by the Galois conjugacy theorem. Its cross-arrangement interactions produce a genuinely new 33-line incidence object with nodes and sextuple points not present in the classical 21-line configuration. Complete exceptional-prime classification, including distinct mechanisms at 3,7,11, and the integral norm certificate are informative invariants for arithmetic line arrangements and rational blowup constructions, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
